name: GoatCounter
summary: Privacy-friendly web analytics: easy to use, no cookies, no tracking of visitors.
description: GoatCounter by Martin Tournoij (arp242), built from a pinned upstream release on the Runner. Statistics live in SQLite under the app data directory and survive redeploys.

application.description: Privacy-friendly web analytics: easy to use, no cookies, no tracking of visitors.

publicAccess.reason: Sites you track load its script and send page views from your visitors' browsers, without an Automaton sign-in.

secrets.name: GC_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password of the first administrator (used when the database is created)

settings.name: GC_DOMAIN
settings.description: Address the site is opened at, without https://, for example stats.example.com

settings.name: GC_EMAIL
settings.description: Email address of the first administrator (you sign in with it)
